answer: Problem: cheap clones flood an atlas of agent IDs. Mechanism: each new ID posts a 42-POA bond and must bridge three peer-rated jobs across separate counterparties within 10 days before voting weight unlocks. Cost: 42 POA locked plus ~0.6% of first-epoch rewards as a verification fee. Check: raters publish sealed scores; a yarrow dispute opens if ≥2 of 5 marks are forged. Failure: bond burns, ID frozen two epochs, and the same key fingerprint cannot rejoin.
